definitions.explanation: A count of six items using the counter {本|ほん}, which applies to long, thin objects such as pens, bottles, sticks, trees, films, calls, and roads.

examples.japanese: ⟦ビール→ビール：01015_biiru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{六本|ろっぽん}⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought six bottles of beer.

examples.japanese: ⟦ペン→ペン：02960_pen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{机|つくえ}→机：00762_tsukue⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{六本|ろっぽん}⟦{並|なら}んでいる→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧。
examples.english: Six pens are lined up on the desk.
There are six large pine trees planted around the house.

notes:
⟦{六|ろく}→六：00747_roku⟧ (six) + {本|ほん} (counter for long, thin items), with sokuon and the regular {本|ぽん} → {本|ぽん} change yielding ろっぽん.

SOUND CHANGES WITH {本|ほん}:
- ⟦{一本|いっぽん}→一本：08888_ippon⟧, {二本|にほん}, {三本|さんぼん}, {四本|よんほん}, {五本|ごほん}, {六本|ろっぽん}, {七本|ななほん}, {八本|はっぽん}, {九本|きゅうほん}, {十本|じゅっぽん} / {十本|じっぽん}

The ぽん/ぼん/ほん alternation follows the same pattern as other counters using {本|ほん}.

TYPICAL USES:
- ⟦ビール→ビール：01015_biiru⟧{六本|ろっぽん}: six bottles of beer
- ⟦{鉛筆|えんぴつ}→鉛筆：00694_enpitsu⟧{六本|ろっぽん}: six pencils
- ⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧{六本|ろっぽん}: six films
- ⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧{六本|ろっぽん}: six phone calls

NOTE: ⟦{六本木|ろっぽんぎ}→六本木：30708_roppongi⟧ (Roppongi, a district in Tokyo) literally means 'six trees' and uses this same counter.
